label: Early input steps 1-2 after a g or 0 (original phase / <DEL>)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original-input phase and on the <DEL> step (99.5% of mass); it is essentially silent during copying and never fires at t=0. Its main trigger is a g or 0 one or two inputs back: rate given prev_tok=g is 46% (8.6x lift), prev_tok=0 is 29%, prev2_tok=g is 33%, and a weaker effect comes from 2. It is strongest at early-to-middle positions (t=2..6, peak at t=3-4). A g/0 that appears late in a long sequence mostly does not trigger it. Top activations (~0.9-1.0) come from sequences starting m g g or m 0 g g, peaking on the token right after the second g; first_tok=m has a 3.2x lift. Weak, diffuse low-magnitude firing at early positions with no g/0 nearby accounts for most of the missed activations. Dev F1 is about 0.62 and mass recall about 0.69.
